title: Quiz: CSS Tooling

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: In CSS, /* */ marks a comment. Block comments use /* ... */.

questions.question: What does Browserslist do?
questions.correctAnswer: Declares which browsers your CSS must support

questions.question: True or False: Tools read it to decide which transforms/polyfills to emit.
What is the main purpose of the CSS Tooling technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you css tooling effectively.

questions.question: In CSS, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
